available.quote: The Department may, upon application in writing on forms or electronically accompanied by the required fee, issue a license as an architect to an applicant licensed under the laws of another state, the District of Columbia, a territory of the United States, or a foreign country if the requirements for licensure in that other jurisdiction were, on the date of original licensure, substantially equivalent to the requirements then in force in this State.

requirements.value: Requirements for licensure in the other jurisdiction must have been substantially equivalent to Illinois requirements on the date of original licensure.
requirements.quote: if the requirements for licensure in that other jurisdiction were, on the date of original licensure, substantially equivalent to the requirements then in force in this State

title_protection.quote: Use of the title "architect" or any of its derivations is limited to those persons or entities licensed or registered under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material misstatement in furnishing information to the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Material misstatement in furnishing information to the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of architecture.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of architecture.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with any of the provisions of this Act or any of the rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with any of the provisions of this Act or any of the rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license or in connection with renewal or restoration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or any misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license or registration under this Act or in connection with applying for renewal or restoration of a license or registration under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Purposefully making false statements or signing false certificates to induce payment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Purposefully making false statements or signing false statements, certificates or affidavits to induce payment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a disqualifying misdemeanor or felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of or entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, finding of guilt, jury verdict, or entry of judgment or sentencing, including, but not limited to, convictions, preceding sentences of supervision, conditional discharge, or first offender probation under the laws of any jurisdiction of the United States that is (i) a misdemeanor, an essential element of which is dishonesty, that is directly related to the practice of the profession of architecture or (ii) a felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or assisting another in violating any provision of this Act or its rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or assisting another in violating any provision of this Act or the rules adopted under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide information in response to a written request by the Department within 60 days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide information in response to a written request made by the Department within 60 days after receipt of the written request.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud or harm the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud or harm the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of controlled substances, alcohol, or other substances resulting in inability to practice safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs defined in law as controlled substances, alcohol, narcotics, stimulants, or any other substances that results in the inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false statement of compliance with the Environmental Barriers Act regarding technical submissions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a statement of compliance pursuant to the Environmental Barriers Act that technical submissions prepared by the architect or prepared under the architect's responsible control for construction or alteration of an occupancy required to be in compliance with the Environmental Barriers Act are in compliance with the Environmental Barriers Act when such technical submissions are not in compliance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay a fine imposed by the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding by the Department that an applicant or licensee has failed to pay a fine imposed by the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of or failure to comply with the terms of probation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding by the Department that the licensee, after having his or her license placed on probationary status, has violated or failed to comply with the terms of probation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety due to physical or mental illness or disability.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice the profession with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety as a result of physical illness, including, but not limited to, deterioration through the aging process, loss of motor skill, mental illness, or disability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another state, territory, or government for grounds substantially equivalent to those in this Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another state, territory, foreign country, the District of Columbia, the United States government, or any other governmental agency if at least one of the grounds for discipline is the same or substantially equivalent to those set forth in this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a willfully false oath or affirmation in any matter required by this Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The making of any willfully false oath or affirmation in any matter or proceeding where an oath or affirmation is required by this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or attempting to use an expired, inactive, suspended, or revoked license or the seal of another or impersonating another licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using or attempting to use an expired, inactive, suspended, or revoked license or the certificate or seal of another or impersonating another licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing, affixing, or allowing the architect's seal to be affixed to any technical submission not prepared by or under the architect's responsible control.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing, affixing, or allowing the architect's seal to be affixed to any technical submission not prepared by the architect or under the architect's responsible control.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Any business, including, but not limited to, a Professional Service Corporation, that includes the practice of architecture within its stated purposes, practices architecture, or holds itself out as available to practice architecture shall register with the Department under this Section.

definition_quote.value: The practice of architecture within the meaning and intent of this Act includes the offering or furnishing of professional services, such as consultation, environmental analysis, feasibility studies, programming, planning, aesthetic and structural design, technical submissions consisting of drawings and specifications and other documents required in the construction process, administration of construction contracts, project representation, and construction management, in connection with the construction of any private or public building, building structure, building project, or addition to or alteration or restoration thereof.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of architecture within the meaning and intent of this Act includes the offering or furnishing of professional services, such as consultation, environmental analysis, feasibility studies, programming, planning, aesthetic and structural design, technical submissions consisting of drawings and specifications and other documents required in the construction process, administration of construction contracts, project representation, and construction management, in connection with the construction of any private or public building, building structure, building project, or addition to or alteration or restoration thereof.

methods_authorized.quote: consultation, environmental analysis, feasibility studies, programming, planning, aesthetic and structural design, technical submissions consisting of drawings and specifications and other documents required in the construction process, administration of construction contracts, project representation, and construction management

interior_design_services_defined.quote: Nothing in this Act or any other Act shall prevent an architect from practicing interior design services.

design_build_authorized.quote: "Design build" or "design build entity" means the project delivery process defined in 68 Ill. Adm. Code 1150.85, and any amendments or changes thereto.

permitted_firm_structures.quote: Any business, including, but not limited to, a Professional Service Corporation, partnership, limited liability company, or professional design firm seeking to be registered under this Section

firm_licensed_architect_ownership_minimu.value: at least one member of the board of directors, partners, or members
firm_licensed_architect_ownership_minimu.quote: the business designates an individual who holds a license under this Act as one of the members of the board of directors, partners, or members of the business and the designated individual will function as the managing agent for the business

seal_required.quote: Every architect shall have a reproducible seal, or facsimile, the impression of which shall contain the name of the architect, the license number, and the words "Licensed Architect, State of Illinois".

value: Farm buildings or structures outside corporate limits of any city or village used for farm purposes or outbuildings/auxiliary buildings in connection with farm premises
Detached single family residence on a single lot (construction, remodeling, or repairing)
Two-family residence of wood frame construction on a single lot, not more than two stories and basement in height (construction, remodeling, or repairing)
Interior design services for buildings which do not involve life safety or structural changes
exempt_building_types.quote: The involvement of an architect is not required for the following: (A) The building, remodeling or repairing of any building or other structure outside of the corporate limits of any city or village, where such building or structure is to be, or is used for farm purposes... (B) The construction, remodeling or repairing of a detached single family residence on a single lot. (C) The construction, remodeling or repairing of a two-family residence of wood frame construction on a single lot, not more than two stories and basement in height. (D) Interior design services for buildings which do not involve life safety or structural changes.

ncarb_standards_adoptable.quote: The Department may adopt, as its own rules relating to diversified professional training, those guidelines published from time to time by the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards.

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.quote: A person or entity not licensed or registered under this Act who has violated any provision of this Act or its rules is guilty of a Class A misdemeanor for the first offense

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_s.quote: a Class 4 felony for a second and subsequent offenses

civil_penalty_maximum.quote: pay a civil penalty to the Department in an amount not to exceed $10,000 for each offense as determined by the Department
